home.emptyText: The overview fills in once the company has employees.

login.hint: Use your company email and password.

reset.hint: After saving, sign in again with the new password on every device.

change.title: Change password
change.hint: After changing it, you will sign in again on every device.

auth.password_too_long: The password is too long. Use at most 72 characters.
auth.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
auth.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
